label: Updated at 12 p.m. ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today's biggest golf stories.

items.headline: LIV Golf's Murky Future
items.text: PGA Tour CEO Brian Rolapp says no special return path is planned for LIV players like Bryson DeChambeau and Jon Rahm, who must clear LIV contracts and follow existing PGA Tour rules to rejoin.

items.headline: McIlroy Expands PGA Tour Role
items.text: Rory McIlroy confirmed an expanded advisory role in PGA Tour policy at the Tour Championship this week.

items.headline: Scheffler Health Update
items.text: Scottie Scheffler revealed he had hand, foot and mouth disease during the BMW Championship but continues preparing for the Tour Championship.
